name: Palace in the sky
desc: a seat of power far above the world, reached only by flight, where the ground is a rumour
tags: white marble palace above the clouds, sea of cloud below the parapet, open sky on all sides, colonnaded terrace, gold domed roof, wide stone stair ending in open air, birds flying at eye level, sunlit cloud tops
prose: a white marble palace standing above a sea of cloud, its parapet looking down onto sunlit cloud tops, open sky on every side, colonnaded terraces and gold domes, and birds passing at eye level
note: Named on its own this is just a castle on a hill. The altitude comes from three nouns and nothing else: cloud tops BELOW the parapet, open sky filling the edges of frame, and birds at eye level. Remove any one and it lands back on the ground. 'Majestic', 'heavenly' and 'ethereal' change nothing - a stair that ends in open air does.
